external.name: HALOWERK OCR
external.description: Returns the text of an image, scan or screenshot in reading order, typed blocks with their box on the page, tables as a matrix plus Markdown, and every QR code and barcode with its decoded content. Runs local OCR (Tesseract); the 402 quotes the exact price from the file.

note: POST the one-page PDF to endpoint to get a provider quote. Repeat the same request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE after the buyer approves the quote. The provider receives the payment.
